demo.intro:
Demo Mode

This is a local simulated run. No external AI provider is called.

Pick a direction from the enhancement table, then review the sample structured prompt below.

options.label: Developers
options.description: Use technical language, constraints, and implementation details.

options.label: Educators
options.description: Use learning goals, examples, and assessment criteria.

options.label: Product teams
options.description: Use goals, trade-offs, acceptance criteria, and user impact.

options.label: Structured brief
options.description: Concise sections with context, task, constraints, and output format.

options.label: Agent instructions
options.description: Step-by-step instructions suitable for coding or research agents.

options.label: Arabic-first
options.description: Arabic phrasing with clear RTL-friendly structure.

options.label: Review-ready
options.description: Include assumptions, risks, and verification steps.

options.label: Production-grade
options.description: Add strict constraints, examples, and acceptance checks.

prompt.title: Document-to-Prompt Assistant
prompt.role: You are a bilingual Arabic/English prompt engineering assistant.
prompt.objective: Turn a vague user idea or uploaded document summary into a clear, reusable AI prompt.
prompt.context: The user may be a developer, educator, writer, or product builder. They need guidance without sending data to a Muharrir server.
constraints: Preserve Arabic RTL readability when the user writes in Arabic.
Return a prompt the user can copy directly.
workflow: Identify the user goal and missing context.
Offer enhancement choices for audience, output style, and quality bar.
Generate a final prompt with role, task, constraints, and output format.
prompt.outputFormat: Markdown with sections: Role, Objective, Context, Constraints, Workflow, Output Format, and Final Prompt.
prompt.finalPrompt: You are a bilingual prompt engineering assistant. Help me transform the following rough idea into a structured AI prompt. Ask up to three clarification questions if needed, then produce a copy-ready prompt with Role, Objective, Context, Constraints, Workflow, and Output Format. Preserve Arabic readability when Arabic is used. Rough idea: {{user_idea}}

creative.name: Creative Writing
creative.starter:
Role: [a creative writer]
Type: [story / article / script / poem]
Topic or idea: [...]
Style and tone: [e.g. gripping, emotional]
Approximate length: [...]

summarize.name: Summarize
summarize.starter:
Role: [a professional summarizer]
Text to summarize: [paste it here]
Deliverable: [e.g. a 5-point summary + the key idea]
Audience: [...]
Length: [...]

translate.name: Translate
translate.starter:
Role: [a professional translator]
From language: [...] To language: [...]
Text: [paste it here]
Requirements: [preserve meaning and tone; clarify tricky terms]

proofreading.name: Proofread & Edit
proofreading.starter:
Role: [a copy editor]
Text: [paste it here]
Task: [fix spelling and grammar, improve clarity, keep the meaning]
Output format: [corrected text + list of key changes]

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.starter:
Role: [a marketing expert]
Product or service: [...]
Target audience: [...]
Task: [e.g. ad copy / catchy headline / campaign idea]
Tone and output format: [...]

email.name: Professional Email
email.starter:
Role: [a professional writing assistant]
Recipient and occasion: [...]
Purpose: [e.g. request a meeting / follow-up / apology]
Tone: [formal / friendly]
Output format: [subject line + email body]

social_media.name: Social Media
social_media.starter:
Role: [a content creator]
Platform: [X / Instagram / LinkedIn]
Topic: [...]
Goal: [engagement / followers / sales]
Deliverable: [ready-to-post copy + relevant hashtags]

product.name: Product Copy
product.starter:
Role: [a product copywriter]
Product and specs: [...]
Audience: [...]
Task: [a sales description that highlights benefits, not just features]
Output format: [headline + paragraph + bullet highlights]

customer_support.name: Customer Support
customer_support.starter:
Role: [a courteous support agent]
Customer message: [paste it here]
Situation: [complaint / question / refund request]
Task: [an empathetic reply with a clear solution and steps]
Tone: [friendly and professional]

business_plan.name: Business Plan
business_plan.starter:
Role: [a business consultant]
Venture: [the idea and target market]
Task: [e.g. business model / feasibility study / SWOT analysis]
Output format: [structured sections with headings and rough numbers]

presentation.name: Presentation
presentation.starter:
Role: [a presentation designer]
Topic: [...]
Audience and duration: [...]
Task: [a slide outline with a title and bullets per slide]
Number of slides: [...]

resume.name: Resume / CV
resume.starter:
Role: [a recruiting expert]
Target role: [...]
My experience and skills: [...]
Task: [e.g. resume / cover letter]
Output format: [structured sections with measurable action verbs]

coding.name: Code Development
coding.starter:
Role: [an expert software engineer in the target language]
Task: [describe the feature or function]
Context: [framework/stack and constraints]
Output format: [commented code + a brief step-by-step explanation]

debugging.name: Debugging
debugging.starter:
Role: [a debugging engineer]
Code and error message: [paste them here]
Expected behavior: [...]
Task: [find the root cause and propose a fix]
Output format: [step-by-step diagnosis + the corrected code]

sql.name: SQL Queries
sql.starter:
Role: [a database expert]
Tables and columns: [describe the schema]
Task: [describe the query you need in words]
Database type: [PostgreSQL / MySQL ...]
Output format: [the SQL query + a brief explanation]

data_analysis.name: Data Analysis
data_analysis.starter:
Role: [a data analyst]
Data: [describe or paste it here]
Task: [e.g. find trends / compare / actionable insights]
Output format: [a table + a key-points summary]

academic.name: Academic Research
academic.starter:
Role: [an academic researcher in the target field]
Topic or research question: [...]
Task: [e.g. literature review / design a methodology / form hypotheses]
Requirements: [cite sources, formal tone]
Output format: [structured sections with headings]

teaching.name: Teach & Explain
teaching.starter:
Role: [an expert teacher]
Topic: [...]
Learner level: [beginner / intermediate / advanced]
Task: [e.g. simple explanation / lesson plan / examples and exercises]
Output format: [progressive steps with examples]

brainstorm.name: Brainstorm
brainstorm.starter:
Role: [a brainstorming partner]
Challenge or goal: [...]
Constraints: [...]
Task: [e.g. 10 diverse ideas, each with pros and cons]
Output format: [a numbered list]

code_review.name: Code Review
code_review.starter:
Role: [an expert code reviewer]
Code: [paste it here]
Context: [language, framework, and purpose]
Task: [review quality, performance, and security; suggest improvements]
Output format: [findings grouped by severity + improved code]

lesson_plan.name: Lesson Planning
lesson_plan.starter:
Role: [an expert teacher in curriculum design]
Subject and topic: [...]
Level and duration: [...]
Task: [a lesson plan with learning goals, activities, and assessment]
Output format: [sections: goals, warm-up, activities, assessment, homework]

paper_summary.name: Paper Summarization
paper_summary.starter:
Role: [a specialist researcher]
Paper: [paste the text or abstract]
Task: [a methodical summary: problem, methodology, results, limitations]
Requirements: [cite sources when referencing other work]
Output format: [structured sections + a brief critical appraisal]

video_script.name: Video Scripting
video_script.description: Scripts for YouTube and short-form platforms
video_script.starter:
Role: [a video scriptwriter]
Topic and platform: [...]
Target duration: [...]
Audience: [...]
Task: [a scene-based script: opening hook, content, closing call to action]
Output format: [table: time, scene, narration, shot directions]
